ledger.claim_text: The tuned mass damper has a total mass of 660 metric tons (728 short tons / 1.45 million lbs).
ledger.source_title: Taipei 101 Damper Official Specifications / Motioneering Inc.
ledger.supporting_excerpt_or_notes: Consists of 41 circular steel plates welded in layers to form a 5.5-meter diameter sphere.

ledger.claim_text: The damper is suspended between the 92nd floor down to the 87th floor.
ledger.source_title: Thornton Tomasetti Structural Engineering Case Study
ledger.supporting_excerpt_or_notes: Hangs from eight 42-millimeter diameter steel cables, two at each corner of the 92nd floor cradle.

ledger.claim_text: The system reduces building sway and structural vibrations by up to 35% to 40%.
ledger.source_title: Wind Tunnel Testing and Dynamic Damper Optimization for Taipei 101
ledger.supporting_excerpt_or_notes: Proven across typhoons and seismic events, transferring kinetic energy to 8 hydraulic viscous dampers.

ledger.claim_text: During Typhoon Soudelor in 2015, the sphere swayed a record 100 cm (39 inches) from center.
ledger.source_title: Taiwan Central Weather Bureau / Taipei 101 Official Observation Logs
ledger.supporting_excerpt_or_notes: Sustained wind gusts exceeded 200 km/h; damper functioned exactly within calculated safety displacement limits.

ledger.claim_text: Taipei 101 stands at 508 meters (1,667 feet) and was the world's tallest building from 2004 to 2010.
ledger.source_title: Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH)
ledger.supporting_excerpt_or_notes: Officially certified at 508 meters height to architectural tip.
